planting: real generated stride prefetcher that compiles, runs and reports metrics, but is behaviourally indistinguishable from doing nothing

evidence.source_caveat: module_effect_control_2026-09-22.jsonl is cited only as corroborating context. Its three incremental rows name probe_noop, probe_next_line and gen_default_s0 yet all record binary_sha256 688278205d6c9fa4 and cycles 1129305, so those rows cannot be attributed to the module they name and are not used here. The comparison that carries this case is the cold-build pair: probe_noop 8a4884c11c4995dc at 1138748 cycles versus gen_default_s0 cc0477f0e1ee0187 at 1138748 cycles, distinct binaries, identical measurement.

attribution_correction.why: The embedded source used static_cast<int64_t> on a champsim::address and does not compile in the pinned image, reproducing verbatim the build_success=false row in the screening log. The successful row for the same module name (binary cc0477f0e1ee0187, 1,138,748 cycles) came from a different directory swept by the same run: run_grid_chain.sh passed --candidate-dirs .tmp/cand .tmp/cand2 .tmp/cand3 .tmp/cand4, whose file counts 5/6/3/3 match the 17 screening rows in order, placing the successful gen_default_s0 inside cand2.
attribution_correction.root_cause: Screening rows record a module name and a delivered-binary digest but no source digest, so 'which file produced this measurement' cannot be answered from the artifact. Module names are not design identifiers: gen_default_s0 exists twice with different content.
attribution_correction.what_was_preserved: design_binary_sha256, reference identities and both cycle counts are unchanged: they always described the cand2 build.
attribution_correction.consequence_for_the_annotation_layer: Both generative annotators had been shown the cand variant's text while the equivalent verdict came from the cand2 build. The four-case annotation was re-run against the corrected source before quoting kappa.

taxonomy_note: E0-E4 audit design-vs-reference equivalence. A nullity escape is equivalent to the no-op and therefore scores E0 here, even though the candidate claims to prefetch. Only the harness's no-op comparison catches it, not the taxonomy.
